pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, rounded polygonal dark regions. Due to image resolution, edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp angularity. Patches on the central flank occupy a larger relative spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected network of light-toned negative space. The pathways exhibit uniform pixel thickness across the mid-flank, forming a topological graph with clearly defined tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background, characterized by a short, stiff textural fringe.
